SEC. 1678. EXTENSION OF PROHIBITION RELATING TO MISSILE DEFENSE 
                          INFORMATION AND SYSTEMS.

    Section 130h(e) of title 10, United States Code, is amended by 
striking ``January 1, 2019'' and inserting ``January 1, 2021''.
